headline: Mercy score their way to the top of the table
dek: Mercy have scored 42 goals this season, more than any other programme, and conceded seventeen while losing only three times. Twelve different players have put their names on the scoresheet.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Goals and standing run in step here: the order of the chart is, near enough, the order of the table, with Queens and Molloy the only neighbours to swap places.

wire.line: St. Thomas Aquinas have scored once all season and are still without a point.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Molloy's visit to St. Thomas Aquinas has passed its date with no result published, as has D'Youville's match on the season's opening day: two matches the record cannot yet count.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three of St. Thomas Aquinas's seven defeats came by forfeit, to Staten Island, Roberts Wesleyan and Daemen.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Astrid Borglund has scored twelve goals from 37 shots as a freshman, and set up three more.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Roberts Wesleyan have won nine matches on nineteen goals, a record that rests on conceding fifteen.

last_match.line: Molloy are the only conference side Mercy have not beaten this season.

next_match.line: Franklin Pierce have already beaten Molloy at home this season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
